verdict.rationale: Activepieces supports least-privilege for agents through action-level tool scoping: an agent given 'Send message' can only post to Slack, and inputs can be locked. Its embeddable MCP gives a backend a token that runs only one user's automations. However, the documented API keys are generated at the platform dashboard level 'to manage multiple projects', with no described scopes, permissions or per-agent restrictions on the credentials themselves. missing for 10: documented scoped/permission-limited API keys, per-agent credential issuance, key expiry/rotation controls, independent corroboration.
